prompt: Put the questions of the lesson’s diagnostic in order.

could they do it if their life depended on it?

is something outside work getting in the way?

choices.text: Give more feedback

choices.text: Because the problem was entirely hers, as she had set no expectations at all

prompt: What are the two honest outcomes of an improvement plan, which the person has to be told?
